{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-9098.9","title":"loadng test_messages.py signature-length tests miss 32-byte and 96-byte tails","description":"SECURITY review of python/tests/loadng/test_messages.py (after 4a8y independent-oracle parse fix).

messages.py from_bytes accepts leftover length only in {0, 48} (RREQ 92-96, RREP 136-140, RERR 175-179). test_from_bytes_rejects_invalid_signature_tail (line 303) parametrizes tail_len = 1, 47, 49 only. Those three values do not lock the spec Schnorr-48 set:

- tail_len=32 is untested. LICHEN previously used 32-byte truncated Ed25519 MICs. A parser that accepts len in {0, 32, 48} (or {0, 32}) still rejects 1/47/49. Deleting the 48-only check in favor of the old 32-byte length would not fail this file. That is a crypto-length downgrade on routing control messages.
- tail_len=96 (2*48) is untested. `len(sig) % 48 == 0` rejects 1/47/49 and accepts a concatenated second signature. Trailing-data acceptance is a parser-differential class (Python stores the tail; rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs from_bytes already ignores bytes past the 36/18 prefix). A 96-byte body can be a signed RREQ to Python and an unsigned RREQ to Rust, or two impls can disagree on which 48 bytes are the SIG.

Valid signed fixtures also take the length from the code under test:

    from lichen.loadng.messages import SIGNATURE_LENGTH
    SIG_WIRE = bytes(range(SIGNATURE_LENGTH))

There is no `assert SIGNATURE_LENGTH == 48` and no literal 48-byte hex SIG independent of that constant. Changing SIGNATURE_LENGTH to 32 updates SIG_WIRE, keeps 47/49 rejected, and the suite stays green.

Hop>15 parse tests (test_rreq_from_bytes_rejects_hop_limit_over_max, test_rrep_from_bytes_rejects_hop_count_over_max) are unsigned-only. A "signed messages are trusted, skip MAX_HOP_LIMIT" branch on the 84-byte path would not fail.

Fix: parametrize leftover lengths with at least {1, 32, 47, 49, 96} on RREQ/RREP/RERR; build SIG_WIRE as 48 independent hex bytes (spec 10.3 / draft-lichen-schnorr-00), and assert SIGNATURE_LENGTH == 48; add one signed hop=16/255 rejection (prefix with hop byte 16/255 plus 48-byte tail).
